name: Free Ball: Volleyball
description:
About This Game

Free Ball is a fast-paced third-person multiplayer volleyball game where you take control of your own character and play a specific role on the court. Every role has unique responsibilities that contribute to your team's success.

Choose from a roster of unique characters, each equipped with their own special abilities that can change the momentum of every rally. Receive powerful serves, make accurate sets, unleash devastating spikes, time your blocks, and outplay your opponents through skill, positioning, and teamwork.

Third-person Volleyball

Experience volleyball from an immersive third-person perspective that puts you directly on the court. Read the play, react to every touch, and execute clutch plays with precise player control.

Select Your Role

Play as a Left Hitter, Middle Hitter, Right Hitter, or Setter. Master each volleyball position, each with its own responsibilities and playstyle. Unleash powerful spikes, form solid blocks, deliver accurate sets, or keep rallies alive with perfectly timed receives.

Unique Characters with Special Abilities

Choose from a diverse roster of characters, each equipped with a signature ability that can turn the momentum of a match. Build team compositions and adapt your strategy around every character's strengths.

Skill-based Gameplay

Success comes from smart decision-making and precise execution. Find the open court and place your attacks exactly where you want them. Every rally is unpredictable. Mix up powerful spikes and roll shots, challenge blockers, defend against relentless attacks, and capitalize on your opponents' mistakes to win crucial points.

Multiplayer Volleyball

Work together with your teammates and execute coordinated combination plays to outplay the competition.
short_desc: Free Ball is a third-person arcade volleyball game where every character has unique special abilities. Pass, set, spike, serve, and block your way through intense multiplayer matches that reward teamwork and precision.
